notes: The pronoun הוּא is explicit and takes only *he*, with the auxiliary and lexical verb staying on יִפְדֶּה under rules 17 and 20.
s007/s008: the ASV writes no *of* between כֹּל and its rectum (*all his iniquities*), so rule 19 has no relational word to place and each noun keeps only its own English.
